Thanks for the demo today — good walkthrough. Two quick clarifying items for our security/compliance team so we can choose a hosting path (hosted API vs dedicated vs private VPC):

1) BAA: We need confirmation that Redwood will sign a BAA and whether that is available for Hosted API customers or if it requires Dedicated/Private. Also would like to see your standard BAA language.

2) SOC2 evidence: our InfoSec needs the latest SOC2 Type II report and an inventory of the controls mapped to data handling for PII/PHI. Do you have a short summary doc that lists what artifacts you can share?

Next steps: can you share items 1 & 2 and a matrix that maps hosting options to time-to-prod and evidence availability?

Thanks,

Tom — hi, Ben from Security. Thanks for the clear constraints. Short answers up front, then details: 

- SOC2 Type II: we can share our full SOC2 Type II report under an NDA/secure link. I'll provide a redacted PDF and a control mapping spreadsheet that indicates where each control impacts token handling, model logs, and retention.

- Hosted API + BAA: We have a standard BAA that we sign for Hosted API customers (covers PHI transit & processing). If you require dedicated storage isolation or customer-managed keys, that tends to push to Dedicated or Private. That said, for many customers Hosted + BAA + our KMS integration (customer key wrapping) satisfies audit requirements.

- Evidence and timelines: SOC2 redacted PDF + control map — 2 business days after your NDA; KMS integration note + architecture diagram — same day; Signed BAA — legal turnaround usually 5–10 business days once countersigned.

- Audit window: We can provide 90-day rolling audit logs for Hosted customers by default. For longer retention (e.g., 1 year), we offer an add-on or Dedicated + longer retention SLA.

If acceptable, proposed path for MedGuard:
1) Sign a short NDA so we can share the SOC2 report and control map.
2) Review SOC2 + control map; confirm if Hosted API with our KMS meets your auditors.
3) If yes, sign BAA and proceed to a limited production pilot on Hosted API. If no, we scope Dedicated or Private VPC and map procurement timeline.

I'll attach the SOC2_summary.pdf and a one-page KMS note. Happy to jump on an InfoSec call next Tue/Thu afternoon (PT).

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Security Solutions, Redwood Inference

- Can you confirm whether the Hosted API option supports customer-managed keys in a way that our auditors consider equivalent to Dedicated/KMS? If not fully equivalent, please call out the gaps (e.g., key custody, separation of duties).

- For audit logs, confirm the schema (what fields are logged) and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM (S3 or Splunk ingestion).

We will run this past procurement/legal for a minimal NDA (only to get SOC2 report). Once we have SOC2 + control map we want to schedule a 45-minute call with Ben and Marissa to walk the control mapping and KMS flow. Proposed windows: Thu 09/11 10–11am PT or Tue 09/16 2–3pm PT. 

If you can confirm the small items above in a short note, I'll push the NDA through. Also — please include a DocuSign link for the BAA template so we can preview signature fields and required countersigners.
